label.purpose: Functional metadata, form labels, and stage UI.

lede.purpose: Hero paragraph with a wider reading rhythm.

motion.name: standard-ease
motion.purpose: Buttons, reveals, and camera-adjacent UI transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber call to action for quotes and enquiry.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 25px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--amber); color: #050708; font: 700 14px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #f3b956; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Phone and supporting actions without amber dominance.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 13px 25px; border: 1px solid rgba(199, 204, 208, 0.38); border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(5, 7, 8, 0.28); color: #f5f6f4; font: 700 14px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease, transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--amber); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square dark field with amber focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-field > span { color: #9aa1a6; font: 700 11px/1.4 'Barlow', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(199, 204, 208, 0.24); border-radius: 0; background: #050708; color: #f5f6f4; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Barlow', Arial, sans-serif; caret-color: var(--amber); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #73797d; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--amber); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(230, 162, 48, 0.14); }

components.name: Showroom Navigation
components.description: Fixed dark navigation with a single amber action.
components.html: The storyCraftFree quote
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; padding: 18px 22px; background: #050708; } .ds-nav-link { color: #f5f6f4; font: 500 12px/1.4 'Barlow', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--amber); } .ds-nav-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 11px 20px; background: var(--amber); color: #050708; font: 700 13px/1 'Barlow Condensed', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Chapter Rail
components.description: Fixed progress indicator that tracks the persistent stage.
components.css: .ds-rail { position: fixed; left: 22px; bottom: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #9aa1a6; font: 700 11px/1.4 'Barlow', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail-name { color: #f5f6f4; } .ds-rail-track { display: block; width: 70px; height: 1px; background: rgba(199, 204, 208, 0.24); overflow: hidden; } .ds-rail-track i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--amber); transform: scaleX(0.2); transform-origin: left; }

components.name: Finish Swatch
components.description: Circular paint selector for the 3D stage.
components.html: <button class="ds-swatch" style="--swatch:#d40000" aria-label="Rosso red finish" aria-pressed="true"></button>
components.css: .ds-swatch { width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 246, 244, 0.34); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--swatch); transition: transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-swatch[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: #f5f6f4; transform: scale(1.18); } .ds-swatch:hover { border-color: var(--amber); } .ds-swatch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--amber); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Workshop Frame
components.description: Gallery frame with a caption scrim over real workshop imagery.
components.css: .ds-frame { position: relative; width: 268px; height: 201px; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(199, 204, 208, 0.18); background: #15191c; } .ds-frame img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; filter: saturate(0.72) contrast(1.08) brightness(0.9); transition: filter 0.5s ease, transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-frame:hover img { filter: saturate(0.9) contrast(1.05) brightness(1); transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-frame figcaption { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 20px 14px 12px; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(5, 7, 8, 0.88)); color: rgba(245, 246, 244, 0.82); font: 600 11px/1.4 'Barlow', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

narrative.overview:
This is a night-time automotive atelier: one vehicle, one continuous turntable, one measured journey through a workshop's capabilities. The interface behaves like gallery architecture rather than a brochure — fixed, dark, restrained, and built around the car's movement. Editorial copy sits in soft black scrims, allowing the 3D stage to remain the protagonist from arrival through enquiry.

The visual world is deliberately quiet. Deep charcoal and near-black tones absorb light; a single warm amber accent behaves like a showroom spot, marking focus, progress, and primary action. Condensed uppercase headings give authority without shouting, while Barlow body copy stays practical and legible for a real local repair business. Depth comes from light, reflection, and layering rather than decorative shadows.
keyCharacteristics: A persistent 3D stage with one car and continuous rotation; no slideshow or model swap.
Alternating left/right copy blocks that let the car travel across the viewport.
Editorial scale, generous negative space, and a 1440px container with responsive page padding.
Amber used as a scarce focal signal, not a general brand wash.
Real workshop photography presented as restrained gallery frames.

rules.name: The One Spotlight Rule
rules.body: Amber marks focus and action; body copy, borders, and large surfaces stay neutral.

rules.name: The Dark Stage Rule
rules.body: The car is lit against near-black. Do not introduce light page backgrounds or broad colour panels.

rules.name: The Condensed Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are uppercase Barlow Condensed; body copy remains sentence case Barlow.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text never drops below 11px; body notes stay at 12px or larger.

rules.name: The Light Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Use reflection, shadow, and gradient falloff for hierarchy; avoid decorative drop shadows on content blocks.

dos: Do keep one Ferrari GLB on stage for the full story.
Do let copy alternate sides while the car moves continuously.
Do keep amber scarce: focus, progress, primary action, and stage lighting.
Do label stage performance figures as illustrative.
Do preserve the verified workshop facts: MRB9647, Maddington, phone, email, hours, and free quote path.
donts: Don't swap models, cut to static car slides, or reset the stage between chapters.
Don't use light backgrounds, playful illustration, or soft rounded cards.
Don't shrink functional text below 11px or use wide tracking on body copy.
Don't imply the Ferrari is a vehicle the workshop repaired.
Don't allow gallery motion to create horizontal document overflow.
